title: God of Martial Arts
altTitles: เทพยุทธ์พลิกลิขิตสวรรค์
description: After dying in a car accident, Lin Feng crosses into another world and awakens in the body of a young master of the Lin Clan who was nearly beaten to death. In this world, strength determines everything: the weak are humiliated and discarded, while the strong have the power to decide who lives and dies. With his new life and memories, Lin Feng vows to cultivate his martial arts, overcome powerful enemies, and rise to the peak of the martial world.
author: Jing Wu Hen
